answers.text: I'm a final-year BPharm student in Nashik. My project was a six-week stability test on a herbal cough syrup, using three batches. In my four-week training at a district hospital pharmacy, I observed about 150 prescriptions dispensed every day, and I helped label stock. I noticed how often a patient's choice depended on what was in stock. I want an MBA to learn the business side of pharma, such as pricing and distribution.
I can't share the formulation details from my project. Our guide asked us to keep the composition confidential because a local company supplied the herbal extract.
I don't know how much stock the hospital pharmacy wasted each month. I only worked in the labelling area, and the store keeper handled the records.
The pharma industry is evolving rapidly with lots of opportunities, and I think I am a strong fit because of my passion for healthcare and my analytical mindset.
